'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Bombing of Odesa (2022–present)|Bombing of Odesa]]
***At least 12 people are injured in a night-time [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian]] missile attack on [[Odesa]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/russia-launches-intense-night-attacks-ukraine-targeting-southern-101472010 (AP via ABC News)]
**[[Crimea attacks (2022–present)|Crimea attacks]]
***A fire occurs at the [[military training]] grounds in [[Crimea]], forcing the [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] of more than 2,000 people and the closure of a nearby highway. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/fire-military-base-crimea-major-highway-closed-russia-backed-governor-2023-07-19/ (Reuters)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***The [[United States]] announces a $1.3 billion military aid package to Ukraine. The package includes four [[NASAMS]] air defense systems, [[anti-tank missile]]s, [[Phoenix Ghost]] and [[AeroVironment Switchblade|Switchblade]] [[Unmanned aerial vehicle|attack drones]], and [[Demining|landmine clearing]] equipment, among others. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/07/19/world/europe/us-ukraine-aid-military-pentagon.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**Nine people are killed and 16 others are injured during the explosion of a bomb in a [[Field (agriculture)|field]] in [[Rutshuru Territory]], [[North Kivu]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/20/nine-dead-16-wounded-in-bomb-blast-in-eastern-dr-congo (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Terrorism in India]]
**Police in [[Bangalore]], [[India]], arrest five men suspected of [[List of thwarted Islamic terrorist attacks|planning a terrorist attack]] in the city. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bengaluru/major-terror-plot-averted-in-bengaluru-5-suspects-arrested/articleshow/101915727.cms (''The Times of India'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*A [[Powerball]] [[lottery]] player from [[California]], United States, becomes the third to win a billion-[[United States dollar|dollar]] prize, with a ticket purchased in [[Los Angeles]] earning the $1 billion jackpot. [https://www.thedailystar.net/news/world/news/winning-1-billion-powerball-jackpot-ticket-sold-california-3373991 (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 34 people are killed and 12 others are injured when a bus collides with a car in [[Tamanrasset Province]], [[Algeria]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/north-africa/2023/07/19/At-least-34-killed-12-wounded-in-road-accident-in-Algeria- (Reuters via Al Arabiya)]
*Sixteen people are killed and eleven others are injured when an electricity [[transformer]] explodes on the banks of the [[Alaknanda River]] in [[Chamoli district]], [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/tragic-electrocution-incident-at-namami-gange-project-site-leaves-16-dead-11-injured-101689791826315.html?utm_source=taboola_widget&utm_medium=taboola_widget&utm_campaign=article_detail_page (Hindustan Times)]
*One person is killed and 48 others are injured during an underground [[gas leak|gas explosion]] in [[Johannesburg]], [[South Africa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-gas-explosion-cars-johannesburg-878ea7823afee7764b766b2f7206c55e (AP)]
*Five people are killed and several others are injured across [[Slovenia]], [[Croatia]], [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] and [[Serbia]], after a [[2023 European heat waves#19 and 21 July storms|storm]] passes through the countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/storm-kills-one-bosnia-injures-dozens-serbia-2023-07-20/ (Reuters)] [https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/news/nation-world/story/2023-07-19/powerful-storm-sweeps-croatia-and-slovenia-after-days-of-heat-killing-at-least-3-people (AP via ''The San Diego Union-Tribune'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[15th BRICS summit]]
**[[South Africa]] confirms that [[Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]], who faces an [[International Criminal Court arrest warrants for Vladimir Putin and Maria Lvova-Belova|arrest warrant]] from the [[International Criminal Court]], will participate remotely in the upcoming [[BRICS]] summit in [[Johannesburg]] rather than attend in person. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/21/world/americas-emea/putin-skips-brics-summit-in-south-africa-to-avoid-arrest/1901550 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*The United States [[International sanctions|sanctions]] multiple [[Central America|Central American]] officials accused of corruption, including former [[President of El Salvador|Presidents]] of [[El Salvador]] [[Mauricio Funes]] and [[Salvador Sánchez Cerén]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/Business/wireStory/state-department-sanctions-2-former-salvadoran-leaders-dozens-101495380 (AP via ABC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*A court in [[Iran]] [[sentence (law)|sentences]] actress [[Afsaneh Bayegan]] to a [[suspended sentence|suspended]] two years in prison for failing to comply with the [[Hijabs in Iran|hijab law]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/iran-imprisons-actress-for-flouting-mandatory-hijab-law/ (AFP via ''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[President of Egypt|Egyptian president]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] [[pardon]]s [[Copts|Coptic]] researcher [[Patrick Zaki]] and the lawyer of political activist [[Alaa Abd El-Fattah]]. Both men had been [[criminal conviction|convicted]] of allegedly disseminating [[fake news]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230719-egypt-s-sisi-pardons-researcher-a-day-after-jailing-sparked-outcry (AFP via France 24)]
*At least two protesters are shot by police, 14 more are hospitalized, and at least 300 are arrested during protests in [[Kenya]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/19/several-people-shot-after-kenyan-security-forces-clash-with-protesters (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*Aftermath of the [[2023 Thai general election]]
**A [[Judiciary of Thailand|Thai court]] suspends [[Move Forward Party]] leader [[Pita Limjaroenrat]]'s status as a lawmaker after accusing him of violating election laws for allegedly holding shares in a media company. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/07/19/asia/thai-court-suspend-pita-limjaroenrat-lawmaker-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*In [[Singapore]], [[Workers' Party (Singapore)|Workers' Party]] member of [[Parliament of Singapore|parliament]] [[Leon Perera]] and member [[Nicole Seah]] resign following the social media dissemination of a video revealing their [[extramarital affair]], which party secretary-general [[Pritam Singh (Singaporean politician)|Pritam Singh]] confirmed. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/two-singapore-opposition-party-members-resign-over-affair-4221630 (AFP via NDTV)]
